title: Voir, envoyer, recevoir et courir au futur
summary: Use `voir`, `envoyer`, `recevoir` and `courir` families with their distinct future stems.
objectives: Avoid overextending irregular forms to `prévoir` and `pourvoir`.

sources.label: University of Texas: irregular future stems

sections.title: `Verr-` and `enverr-` are useful exceptions
paragraphs: `Voir` uses `verr-` in the future. `Revoir` (see again) adds `re-`: `reverr-`. `Envoyer` uses `enverr-`, not the `-oyer` pattern `envoier-`. `Renvoyer` (send back) uses `renverr-`. Each takes the same six future endings.

Do not give every verb ending in `-voir` the same stem. `Prévoir` (foresee or plan) has `prévoir-`: `je prévoirai, tu prévoiras, il/elle/on prévoira, nous prévoirons, vous prévoirez, ils/elles prévoiront`. `Pourvoir` (provide for or fill a post) has `pourvoir-` with the same endings. Vocabulary: `un reçu` (masculine), a receipt; `une consigne` (feminine), an instruction.
points: `Revoir: je reverrai, tu reverras, il/elle/on reverra, nous reverrons, vous reverrez, ils/elles reverront`.
`Renvoyer: je renverrai, tu renverras, il/elle/on renverra, nous renverrons, vous renverrez, ils/elles renverront`.

examples.french:
je **verrai**
tu **verras**
il/elle/on **verra**
nous **verrons**
vous **verrez**
ils/elles **verront**
examples.english:
I will see
you will see (singular)
he/she/one will see
we will see
you will see (plural or polite)
they will see

examples.french:
j'**enverrai**
tu **enverras**
il/elle/on **enverra**
nous **enverrons**
vous **enverrez**
ils/elles **enverront**
examples.english:
I will send
you will send (singular)
he/she/one will send
we will send
you will send (plural or polite)
they will send
We will go over the instructions again together.
examples.note: `Revoir` can mean review as well as see again.

examples.english: I will allow a safety margin.

mistakes.why: `Envoyer` is an exception to the usual `-oyer` future pattern.

sections.title: `-Cevoir` becomes `-cevr-`
paragraphs: `Recevoir` gives `recevr-`. Other common `-cevoir` verbs follow it: `apercevoir` (catch sight of) gives `apercevr-`, `percevoir` (perceive or collect) `percevr-`, `concevoir` (conceive or design) `concevr-` and `décevoir` (disappoint) `décevr-`. There is no cedilla before `e` in these stems.

To form a derivative for any person, preserve its prefix and use `-cevrai, -cevras, -cevra, -cevrons, -cevrez, -cevront`. `Concevoir`, for example: `je concevrai, tu concevras, il/elle/on concevra, nous concevrons, vous concevrez, ils/elles concevront`.
points: `Apercevoir` is a brief perception; `voir` is the broader verb see.

examples.french:
je **recevrai**
tu **recevras**
il/elle/on **recevra**
nous **recevrons**
vous **recevrez**
ils/elles **recevront**
examples.english:
I will receive
you will receive (singular)
he/she/one will receive
we will receive
you will receive (plural or polite)
they will receive
examples.note: The stem loses the `oi` of the infinitive.

examples.french: Depuis le pont, vous **apercevrez** le phare.
examples.english: From the bridge, you will catch sight of the lighthouse.

examples.french: Cette version ne **décevra** pas les lecteurs.
examples.english: This version will not disappoint readers.
examples.note: `Décevoir` keeps its initial accent, but needs no `ç` before `e`.

mistakes.why: `C` already has its soft sound before `e`; do not use `ç`.

sections.title: `Courir` loses `i` and doubles `r`
paragraphs: `Courir` uses `courr-` rather than `courir-`. The same future change appears in `parcourir` (cover or travel through), `accourir` (rush over), `recourir` (resort to) and `secourir` (help or rescue): `parcourr-, accourr-, recourr-, secourr-`. Add `-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont` after each.
Do not confuse `courrons`, we will run, with `courons`, we run. The extra `r` carries grammatical information even when pronunciation offers little help.
points: `Recourir` is followed by `à`: `nous recourrons à une autre méthode`.

examples.french:
je **courrai**
tu **courras**
il/elle/on **courra**
nous **courrons**
vous **courrez**
ils/elles **courront**
examples.english:
I will run
you will run (singular)
he/she/one will run
we will run
you will run (plural or polite)
they will run

examples.french: Les participantes **parcourront** la ville à pied.
examples.english: The participants will travel through the city on foot.

examples.french: Nous **recourrons** à une carte papier si nécessaire.
examples.english: We will use a paper map if necessary.
examples.note: A `courir`-family verb need not describe physical running.

sections.title: Apercevoir quelque chose ou s'apercevoir de quelque chose
paragraphs: `Apercevoir` takes what you catch sight of directly. `S'apercevoir de` means become aware of or realize something, not literally see yourself. With a whole statement, use `s'apercevoir que` + clause. Keep the reflexive pronoun with this awareness meaning and keep `de` before a noun; do not combine `de` with `que` in this construction.

The future stem stays `apercevr-`. Full reflexive forms: `je m'apercevrai, tu t'apercevras, il/elle/on s'apercevra, nous nous apercevrons, vous vous apercevrez, ils/elles s'apercevront`. `Me`, `te` and `se` elide before the initial vowel; `nous` and `vous` do not.
points: Vocabulary: `une anomalie` (feminine), an anomaly; `une fumée` (feminine), smoke.

examples.french: Du belvédère, vous **apercevrez** la fumée au-dessus des toits.
examples.english: From the lookout, you will catch sight of the smoke above the roofs.
examples.note: A direct object names what can be seen.

examples.french: En comparant les factures, vous **vous apercevrez de** l'anomalie.
examples.english: By comparing the invoices, you will become aware of the anomaly.
examples.note: The reflexive construction plus `de` expresses realization.

examples.french: Tu **t'apercevras que** les deux codes sont identiques.
examples.english: You will realize that the two codes are identical.
examples.note: `Que` introduces the whole statement; no `de` appears before it.

practice.prompt: Supply voir in the future: Nous ___ le résultat demain.
Supply envoyer in the future: Elle ___ le devis.
Supply recevoir in the future: Tu ___ une invitation.
Supply courir in the future: Je ___ samedi matin.
Supply renvoyer in the future: Vous ___ le formulaire signé.
Supply revoir in the future: Ils ___ leur formatrice lundi.
Supply prévoir in the future: Nous ___ deux heures pour la visite.
Supply apercevoir in the future: Vous ___ la mer après le tunnel.
Supply concevoir in the future: Nous ___ un nouvel outil.
Supply décevoir in the future: Cette décision ne ___ personne.
Supply courir in the future: Nous ___ au bord du canal.
practice.explanation: Courrons is future; courons is present.

practice.prompt: Supply parcourir in the future: Elles ___ le sentier demain.
Supply envoyer in the future: J'___ une copie à l'équipe.
Supply percevoir in the future: Les artistes ___ leurs droits en juin.
practice.explanation: Percevoir can mean receive money; the stem is percevr-.

practice.prompt: Supply recourir in the future: Vous ___ à un spécialiste.
practice.explanation: Recourir keeps à and takes recourr-.

practice.prompt: Supply recevoir in the future: Les candidates ___ un courriel.
Supply pourvoir in the future: Le service ___ les postes vacants.
practice.explanation: Pourvoir retains pourvoir-, unlike voir's verr-.

practice.prompt: Supply accourir in the future: Nous ___ dès votre appel.
practice.explanation: Accourir keeps ac- before courir's courr- stem.

practice.prompt: Supply secourir in the future: Vous ___ les personnes en difficulté.
practice.explanation: Secourir uses secourr- with the future ending -ez.

practice.prompt: Use s'apercevoir in the future, including its preposition, to mean become aware of: Nous ___ cette différence après le contrôle.
practice.explanation: Nous nous apercevrons de names a future realization; the first nous is already printed as the subject.

practice.prompt: Complete with s'apercevoir in the future and que, meaning realize that: Elle ___ le dossier est vide.
practice.explanation: A whole clause follows que; s' is the required reflexive pronoun, and there is no de before que.

practice.prompt: Which future sentence describes becoming aware of a mistake rather than catching sight of a physical object?
practice.explanation: S'apercevoir de is the awareness construction; apercevoir + object is visual perception.

production_task.prompt: Write an itinerary update for a walking group. Include a message you will send, information they will receive, something they will see and the route they will cover.
production_task.model_answer: Je vous enverrai le plan ce soir. Vous recevrez aussi les consignes de sécurité. Depuis la colline, nous verrons le fleuve. Nous parcourrons ensuite le quartier du port.
production_task.translation: I will send you the map this evening. You will also receive the safety instructions. From the hill, we will see the river. We will then walk through the port neighbourhood.
rubric: Keep the distinct stems for sending, receiving, seeing and covering a route.
Make the update a usable sequence of information.
